---
title: "Isla Verde Registry Raises Stamp Fee to 0.5% From July"
description: "The Isla Verde land registry raised its stamp fee from 0.4% to 0.5% of the declared price on 1 July 2026. Contracts signed before that date keep the old rate."
pubDate: 2026-07-01
author: Isla Verde Editorial
---

The registry stamp fee rose from 0.4% to 0.5% on 1 July 2026 for every transfer registered from that date.
